+func (ls Labels) String() string {
+	if ls.Len() == 0 {
+		return "{}"
+	}
+

+	size := 2 // {} brackets
+	sepLen := 2 // ", " separator
+	ls.Range(func(l Label) {
+		size += len(l.Name) + 1 // +1 for '='
+		// Approximate quoted string size: worst case is 3x (e.g., all quotes), but average is much lower.

+		size += len(strconv.Quote(l.Value))
+	})
+	size += (ls.Len() - 1) * sepLen // separators between labels

+	buf.Grow(size)
+	buf.WriteByte('{')

+		}

+		buf.WriteByte('=')
+		buf.Write(strconv.AppendQuote(nil, l.Value))
+	})

+	return buf.String()
